mentions.title: De la Rosa on how Aston Martin’s risky upgrades paid off
mentions.summary: Pedro de la Rosa reflected on the success of Aston Martin’s major upgrades and working with Adrian Newey in the latest episode of Beyond The Grid.

mentions.title: Ferrari to bring upgraded engine to Italian GP under ADUO
mentions.summary:
Ferrari will introduce an upgrade to its Formula 1 power unit at this weekend’s Italian Grand Prix with it permitted under the Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities system.

mentions.title: Ferrari’s ADUO 2 upgrade is no “game changer” for Haas either
mentions.summary:
Oliver Bearman says Ferrari’s ADUO 2 engine upgrade represents “a much smaller step” than Haas’ updated Formula 1 chassis.

mentions.title: Even with ADUO 2 upgrade, Ferrari is “missing pure power”
mentions.summary:
Ferrari Formula 1 team principal Fred Vasseur says the Scuderia was never going to reach Mercedes’ level in 2026, in terms of engine power.
